## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) Jñānagupta is a Mahāyāna sūtra on the awakening of the *jué jìng xīn* 覺淨心 (Skt. *bodhi-citta*-purification) and its cultivation in the bodhisattva path. The work was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) Jñānagupta's Suí-imperial-bureau activity, c. 587 – 600 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The Taishō text (T0327) is established on the standard apparatus.
